title: Barbershop
style: Upbeat 1940s barbershop quartet a cappella song. Four male harmony voices (lead, tenor, baritone, bass). Playful swing rhythm, finger snaps, bright close chords, vintage nightclub vibe, fun and classy lyrics about having a good time out on the town. No instruments.
lyrics:
Intro (All voices – upbeat, finger snaps)
Ba-da-da-dah, ba-da-da-dah!
Go, go, go, go!
Go on, fellas, it’s your birthday
We’re gonna swing like it’s your birthday!
Raise your glass, it’s feelin’ Thursday
And we don’t care if it’s your birthday!

Chorus (Full Quartet)
You can find me at the club, drinkin’ bubbles of gold
Feelin’ mighty fine, never doin’ what I’m told.
We’re here to dance and laugh, that’s enough
So come on give me love if you’re into good stuff!
You can find me at the club, feet tappin’ in time
Got a table and a tune and I’m feelin’ sublime.
We’re here to swing, yeah, we can’t get enough
So come on give me love if you’re into good stuff!

Verse 1 (Lead with harmony responses)
Lead
When I pull up, shine so bright
All: (Shine so bright!)
Lead
Steppin’ out clean on a Friday night
All: (Friday night!)
Lead
The fellas nod and the ladies grin
The party starts when we walk in!

Lead
Got my hat tipped low and my shoes that gleam
All: (Shoes that gleam!)
Lead
Feelin’ smooth like a silver dream.
The band starts swingin’, the brass goes boom
We’re four-part harmony fillin’ the room!

Chorus (Full Quartet)
You can find me at the club, bottle full of cheer
Clappin’ on the beat with the crowd so near!
We’re not in a rush, we’re just here to have fun
Come and join the groove ‘til the night is done!
You can find me at the club, laughin’ loud and bold
With a grin on my face and a heart of gold.
We’re here to sing, yeah, that’s enough
So come on give me love if you’re into good stuff!

Bridge (Soft, jazzy swing – close harmony)
My tune, my show, brought me this glow
A little rhythm and a little dough
My car, my charm, my lucky shoes
I’ve been around the block, I can’t lose!

Verse 2 (Lead with group “doo-wop” background)
Lead
Now some folks stare, some folks talk
All: (Talk, talk, talk!)
Lead
But I just dance my walkin’ walk!
They say, “Hey, man, what’s your plan?”
I say, “Just to sing with my harmony band!”

All
We’re swingin’ smooth, we’re never late
That barbershop groove feels first-rate!
Grab your coat and come on through
We’ll save a spot right next to you!

Final Chorus (Full Quartet – big finish)
Find me at the club, drinkin’ bubbles of gold
Feelin’ mighty fine, never doin’ what I’m told.
We’re here to dance and laugh, that’s enough
So come on give me love if you’re into good stuff!
Find me at the club, swingin’ all night long
Harmony tight and the beat is strong!
We’re here to sing, yeah, that’s enough
So come on give me love if you’re into good stuff!

Tag (Slow, rich barbershop chord)
Ba-da-da-doo...
Find me at the club...
If you’re into good stuff!
